title: Bhayya Ali Akbar Bhayya Ali Akbar
body:
beemar behen ko na bhulana ali akber
<<MINI>>
bhayya ali akbar bhayya ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
har haal me vaade ko nibhana ali akber
<<MINI>>
bhayya ali akber bhayya ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
likhti hu'n larazte huwe hathou'n se ye nama, beemar hu'n bhayya, baba ko mera khat ye dikhana ali akber
<<MINI>>
bhayya ali akberbhayya ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
kehna ke mai achchi hyu'n ab paas bulalo, seene se lagalo, tanhayi me dushwaar hai jeena ali akber
<<MINI>>
bhayya ali akber bhayya ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
tumne ye hame kehke amaari se utara, rutho na khudara, bulwayenge jaldi tumhe baba ali akber
<<MINI>>
bhayya ali akber bhayya ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
din raat tasavvur me jhulati hu'n mai jhula, dil 3rota hai mera, yaad aata hai asgher ka humakna ali akber
<<MINI>>
bhayya ali akber bhayya ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes me tehraaye phupi gar teri shadi, kardena manadi, shadi me chali aayegi sughra ali akber
<<MINI>>
bhayya ali akber bhayya ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
hai peshe nazar mere tere naqshe kafe pa, aye dilbar-e-laila, hasrat hai ke dekhu'n tera chehra ali akber
<<MINI>>
bhayya ali akberbhayya ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle haram ko qasim o abid ko chacha ko, aur shaahe huda ko, kehna salaam kehti hai sughra ali akber
<<MINI>>
bhayya ali akber bhayya ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
gar baad mere aana pade tumko madina, sunlo mera kehna, sehra meri turbat pe bandhana ali akber
<<MINI>>
bhay ya ali akber bhayya ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
mazher yahi sughra ne likha khat ki jabee'n par, aye mere baradar
yaad aati hai ab mujhko sakina ali akber
<<MINI>>
bhayya ali akber bhayya ali akber
